regime.label: Saudi Arabia - ZATCA phase 2 integration
regime.correction_mechanism: credit note (381) or debit note (383) through the same integration
regime.scope: Phase 1 applies to every resident VAT taxpayer. Phase 2 has reached taxpayers through wave 24 (revenue above SAR 375,000); wave 25 (above SAR 187,500 in any of 2022 to 2025) integrates by 2027-02-01.

commencement.scope: Phase 1 (generation): every resident VAT taxpayer issues invoices from a compliant e-invoicing solution
commencement.notes: QR code mandatory on simplified invoices from this date; integration with Fatoora came in waves.

commencement.scope: Phase 2 (integration) wave 1: clearance of standard and reporting of simplified invoices through Fatoora, for VAT-subject revenue above SAR 3,000,000,000 in 2021
commencement.notes: Integration window 2023-01-01 to 2023-06-30. As reproduced by EY from ZATCA's announcements; needs expert review against ZATCA's own list.

regime.notes: Standard tax invoices (KSA-2 01xxxxx, B2B and B2G) are cleared before they reach the buyer; simplified invoices (02xxxxx, B2C) are stamped by the seller and reported within 24 hours. Which act a document goes through is read from its own subtype.

deadlines.notes: Simplified invoices are reported within 24 hours of issuance; standard invoices are cleared before they are shared with the buyer.

qr.notes: Tags 7 to 9 (ECDSA signature and keys) are written by the signing step with the tenant's CSID.
